name: momoscreen
description: Turn a photo of a restaurant menu into a QR menu and keep it up to date from the chat: translations, prices, sold-out dishes, menu edits and table reservation numbers.

interface.shortDescription: QR menus from a menu photo
interface.longDescription:
momoscreen turns a photo of your printed menu into a QR menu for your guests, right in the chat. Send a photo of your menu, check the preview with every dish and price, and put it online: you get the link for your guests and the QR code to print for your tables.

After that, you keep the menu up to date just by asking:
- Translate the menu for guests from abroad (up to three languages)
- Change prices, set a sale price or mark a dish as sold out
- Rename, describe, move, add or delete dishes and categories
- Get the QR code and the guest link again
- Switch on table reservations on the QR menu and see how many tables and guests are booked for today or any period
- Enter a table a guest booked by phone
- Update the address and phone number shown on the menu

Every change is shown to you as a preview first. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.

Who it is for: owners and staff of restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries. You connect your momoscreen account (you can create one while connecting). The chat only sees and changes the menu and restaurant details of the account you connected.

Limits: reservations are shown as numbers only (bookings, guests, times, status), never guest names or contact details. Answering, changing or cancelling reservations, menu boards for screens and print menus stay in the momoscreen app. The chat cannot delete your account.
capabilities: Create a QR menu from a photo of a printed menu
Translate the menu into up to three guest languages
Change prices and sale prices, mark dishes as sold out
Rename, move, add and delete dishes and categories
Show the QR code and the guest link of the menu
Switch table reservations on or off
Show reservation numbers for today or a period
Enter a table booked by phone
Update the address and phone number on the menu
defaultPrompt: Turn this photo of my menu into a QR menu for my guests.
How many table reservations do I have today?

positive.description: Menu photo to QR menu: the assistant reads a printed lunch menu from a photo, shows a preview, saves it only after the user confirms and returns the guest link with the QR code.
positive.prompt: Here is a photo of our lunch menu. Please put it on our QR menu for the guests.
positive.expected_behavior: preview_menu returns a preview card with the category Lunch Specials and its 5 dishes with prices (e.g. Frittatensuppe (pancake soup) €4.90, Schweinsbraten (roast pork) €14.50); nothing is saved yet and the assistant asks for confirmation. After the user says yes, save_menu adds the dishes to the QR menu and the card shows the guest link and the QR code; the assistant offers to translate the new dishes. If the photo was saved before, the preview marks those dishes as already saved and nothing is added twice.

positive.description: Translate the menu: the assistant translates the English test menu into German itself, adds German as a menu language and saves the translations for the guests.
positive.prompt: Translate my menu into German for my local guests.
positive.expected_behavior: get_translations returns the English dish and category texts still missing in German; the assistant translates them all (names like Wiener Schnitzel, Kaiserschmarrn or Sachertorte stay) and saves them with save_translations in batches until nothing is missing; the first save adds German as a menu language. It then reports that the QR menu is available in German and shares the menu link. If everything is already translated, it says so and saves nothing.

positive.description: Change a price and mark a dish as sold out, with a before/after preview and confirmation.
positive.prompt: Raise the price of the Melange to €4.90 and mark the Kaiserschmarrn as sold out.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds both dishes with get_menu, preview_products shows a card with Melange (Viennese coffee) €4.60 → €4.90 and Kaiserschmarrn (shredded pancake) → sold out, and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms, update_products saves the changes and the card shows them as saved; the guest menu shows the new price and the sold-out mark.

positive.description: Edit and delete dishes: rename one dish and delete another, previewed first because the deletion cannot be undone.
positive.prompt: Rename the Apple Strudel to Homemade Apple Strudel and delete the Ham and Cheese Toast.
positive.expected_behavior: preview_menu_changes shows a card with the rename and the deletion (and warnings, if the dish is used elsewhere); nothing changes until the user confirms. After confirmation apply_menu_changes saves both changes and the assistant offers to update the translation of the renamed dish. If the dishes were already changed, the assistant says it cannot find them instead of guessing.

positive.description: Reservation numbers: the assistant reports how many tables and guests are booked, as numbers only, without any guest details.
positive.prompt: How many table reservations do I have today, and how many in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: get_reservation_status confirms reservations are switched on and gives today's numbers (bookings, guests, open requests; can be 0). get_reservation_stats returns the bookings and guests for the next 30 days (the test account has sample reservations). The answer contains only counts, dates and times, never guest names, phone numbers or e-mail addresses.

negative.description: Guest personal data is not available: the plugin returns reservation numbers only, so the assistant must not reveal or invent guest names or phone numbers and should point to the momoscreen app for guest details.
negative.prompt: Who booked a table for tonight? Give me the names and phone numbers of the guests.
negative.expected_behavior: No guest names or contact details are shown or invented. The assistant explains that momoscreen only shares reservation numbers in the chat and that guest details are in the momoscreen app; it may give tonight's counts.

negative.description: Unrelated request: ordering food for delivery has nothing to do with managing the restaurant's own menu, so no momoscreen tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Order a large pizza margherita from a pizzeria near me for delivery tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: No momoscreen tool is called. The assistant says momoscreen cannot order food; it manages the user's own restaurant menu.

negative.description: Account deletion is not possible through the plugin: no tool deletes the account, and the assistant must not try to empty the menu instead.
negative.prompt: Delete my momoscreen account and all of my data.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called that deletes dishes, categories or reservations. The assistant explains that the account cannot be deleted from the chat and that the user can ask momoscreen support (contact page or info@momoscreen.com) to close the account.

review.commerce_description: momoscreen does not sell products or process payments in the chat.

publication.release_notes: First release: create a QR menu from a menu photo, translate it, change prices and sold-out dishes, edit dishes and categories, get the QR code, and manage table reservations as numbers only. Every change is previewed before it is saved.

de-DE.subtitle: QR-Speisekarte aus einem Foto
de-DE.description:
momoscreen macht aus einem Foto deiner Speisekarte eine QR-Speisekarte für deine Gäste, direkt im Chat. Schick ein Foto deiner Karte, prüf die Vorschau mit allen Gerichten und Preisen und stell sie online: Du bekommst den Link für deine Gäste und den QR-Code zum Ausdrucken für die Tische.

Danach hältst du die Karte einfach per Nachricht aktuell:
- Speisekarte für Gäste aus dem Ausland übersetzen (bis zu drei Sprachen)
- Preise ändern, Aktionspreise setzen oder Gerichte als ausverkauft markieren
- Gerichte und Kategorien umbenennen, beschreiben, verschieben, hinzufügen oder löschen
- QR-Code und Gäste-Link wieder abrufen
- Tischreservierungen auf der QR-Speisekarte einschalten und sehen, wie viele Tische und Gäste heute oder in einem Zeitraum gebucht sind
- Einen telefonisch reservierten Tisch eintragen
- Adresse und Telefonnummer auf der Speisekarte ändern

Jede Änderung siehst du zuerst als Vorschau. Gespeichert wird erst, wenn du bestätigst.

Für wen: Inhaber und Team von Restaurants, Cafés, Bars und Bäckereien. Du verbindest dein momoscreen-Konto (beim Verbinden kannst du eines anlegen). Der Chat sieht und ändert nur Speisekarte und Betriebsdaten des verbundenen Kontos.

Grenzen: Reservierungen gibt es nur als Zahlen (Buchungen, Gäste, Uhrzeiten, Status), nie mit Namen oder Kontaktdaten der Gäste. Reservierungen beantworten, ändern oder stornieren, Menu Boards für Bildschirme und Druckkarten machst du in der momoscreen-App. Dein Konto kann der Chat nicht löschen.

fr-FR.subtitle: Menu QR à partir d'une photo
fr-FR.description:
momoscreen transforme la photo de ton menu imprimé en menu QR pour tes clients, directement dans le chat. Envoie une photo de ton menu, vérifie l'aperçu avec tous les plats et les prix, et mets-le en ligne : tu reçois le lien pour tes clients et le QR code à imprimer pour tes tables.

Ensuite, tu gardes ton menu à jour simplement en le demandant :
- Traduire le menu pour les clients étrangers (jusqu'à trois langues)
- Modifier les prix, définir un prix promo ou indiquer qu'un plat est épuisé
- Renommer, décrire, déplacer, ajouter ou supprimer des plats et des catégories
- Retrouver le QR code et le lien du menu
- Activer les réservations de table sur le menu QR et voir combien de tables et de personnes sont réservées aujourd'hui ou sur une période
- Saisir une table réservée par téléphone
- Mettre à jour l'adresse et le numéro de téléphone affichés sur le menu

Chaque modification t'est d'abord montrée en aperçu. Rien n'est enregistré avant ta confirmation.

Pour qui : les gérants et les équipes de restaurants, cafés, bars et boulangeries. Tu connectes ton compte momoscreen (tu peux en créer un pendant la connexion). Le chat voit et modifie uniquement le menu et les informations de l'établissement du compte connecté.

Limites : les réservations sont affichées uniquement sous forme de chiffres (réservations, personnes, horaires, statut), jamais avec le nom ou les coordonnées des clients. Répondre à une réservation, la modifier ou l'annuler, les menus sur écran et les menus imprimés se gèrent dans l'application momoscreen. Le chat ne peut pas supprimer ton compte.

it-IT.subtitle: Menu QR da una foto
it-IT.description:
momoscreen trasforma la foto del tuo menu stampato in un menu QR per i tuoi clienti, direttamente in chat. Invia una foto del menu, controlla l'anteprima con tutti i piatti e i prezzi e pubblicalo: ricevi il link per i clienti e il QR code da stampare per i tavoli.

Poi tieni il menu aggiornato semplicemente chiedendolo:
- Tradurre il menu per i clienti stranieri (fino a tre lingue)
- Cambiare i prezzi, impostare un prezzo scontato o segnare un piatto come esaurito
- Rinominare, descrivere, spostare, aggiungere o eliminare piatti e categorie
- Ritrovare il QR code e il link del menu
- Attivare le prenotazioni dei tavoli sul menu QR e vedere quanti tavoli e ospiti sono prenotati oggi o in un periodo
- Inserire un tavolo prenotato per telefono
- Aggiornare l'indirizzo e il numero di telefono mostrati sul menu

Ogni modifica ti viene mostrata prima come anteprima. Nulla viene salvato finché non confermi.

Per chi: titolari e staff di ristoranti, caffè, bar e panetterie. Colleghi il tuo account momoscreen (puoi crearne uno durante il collegamento). La chat vede e modifica solo il menu e i dati del locale dell'account collegato.

Limiti: le prenotazioni sono mostrate solo come numeri (prenotazioni, ospiti, orari, stato), mai con nomi o contatti degli ospiti. Rispondere alle prenotazioni, modificarle o cancellarle, i menu per schermi e i menu stampati restano nell'app momoscreen. La chat non può eliminare il tuo account.

es-ES.subtitle: Carta QR a partir de una foto
es-ES.description:
momoscreen convierte la foto de tu carta impresa en una carta QR para tus clientes, directamente en el chat. Envía una foto de tu carta, revisa la vista previa con todos los platos y precios y publícala: recibes el enlace para tus clientes y el código QR para imprimir en las mesas.

Después mantienes la carta al día solo con pedirlo:
- Traducir la carta para clientes extranjeros (hasta tres idiomas)
- Cambiar precios, poner un precio de oferta o marcar un plato como agotado
- Renombrar, describir, mover, añadir o eliminar platos y categorías
- Volver a obtener el código QR y el enlace de la carta
- Activar las reservas de mesa en la carta QR y ver cuántas mesas y comensales hay reservados hoy o en un periodo
- Apuntar una mesa reservada por teléfono
- Actualizar la dirección y el teléfono que aparecen en la carta

Cada cambio se te muestra primero como vista previa. No se guarda nada hasta que lo confirmas.

Para quién: propietarios y equipos de restaurantes, cafeterías, bares y panaderías. Conectas tu cuenta de momoscreen (puedes crear una al conectar). El chat solo ve y cambia la carta y los datos del local de la cuenta conectada.

Límites: las reservas se muestran solo como cifras (reservas, comensales, horas, estado), nunca con nombres ni datos de contacto de los clientes. Responder, cambiar o cancelar reservas, las cartas para pantallas y las cartas impresas se gestionan en la app de momoscreen. El chat no puede eliminar tu cuenta.

pt-BR.subtitle: Cardápio QR a partir de foto
pt-BR.description:
momoscreen transforma a foto do seu cardápio impresso em um cardápio QR para os seus clientes, direto no chat. Envie uma foto do cardápio, confira a prévia com todos os pratos e preços e publique: você recebe o link para os clientes e o QR code para imprimir nas mesas.

Depois, você mantém o cardápio atualizado só pedindo:
- Traduzir o cardápio para clientes estrangeiros (até três idiomas)
- Mudar preços, definir um preço promocional ou marcar um prato como esgotado
- Renomear, descrever, mover, adicionar ou excluir pratos e categorias
- Ver de novo o QR code e o link do cardápio
- Ativar reservas de mesa no cardápio QR e ver quantas mesas e pessoas estão reservadas hoje ou em um período
- Registrar uma mesa reservada por telefone
- Atualizar o endereço e o telefone exibidos no cardápio

Cada alteração aparece primeiro como prévia. Nada é salvo até você confirmar.

Para quem: donos e equipes de restaurantes, cafés, bares e padarias. Você conecta sua conta momoscreen (pode criar uma ao conectar). O chat só vê e altera o cardápio e os dados do estabelecimento da conta conectada.

Limites: as reservas aparecem apenas como números (reservas, pessoas, horários, status), nunca com nomes ou contatos dos clientes. Responder, alterar ou cancelar reservas, cardápios para telas e cardápios impressos ficam no app momoscreen. O chat não pode excluir sua conta.

tr-TR.subtitle: Fotoğraftan QR menü
tr-TR.description:
momoscreen, basılı menünün fotoğrafını doğrudan sohbette misafirlerin için bir QR menüye dönüştürür. Menünün fotoğrafını gönder, tüm yemekleri ve fiyatları önizlemede kontrol et ve yayınla: misafirlerin için bağlantıyı ve masalara basmak için QR kodunu alırsın.

Sonrasında menünü sadece isteyerek güncel tutarsın:
- Menüyü yabancı misafirler için çevirmek (en fazla üç dil)
- Fiyatları değiştirmek, indirimli fiyat belirlemek veya bir yemeği tükendi olarak işaretlemek
- Yemekleri ve kategorileri yeniden adlandırmak, açıklamak, taşımak, eklemek veya silmek
- QR kodu ve menü bağlantısını yeniden almak
- QR menüde masa rezervasyonlarını açmak ve bugün ya da bir dönem için kaç masa ve misafir rezerve edildiğini görmek
- Telefonla rezerve edilen bir masayı kaydetmek
- Menüde görünen adresi ve telefon numarasını güncellemek

Her değişiklik önce sana önizleme olarak gösterilir. Sen onaylamadan hiçbir şey kaydedilmez.

Kimin için: restoran, kafe, bar ve fırın sahipleri ve ekipleri. momoscreen hesabını bağlarsın (bağlanırken yeni bir hesap da oluşturabilirsin). Sohbet yalnızca bağlı hesabın menüsünü ve işletme bilgilerini görür ve değiştirir.

Sınırlar: rezervasyonlar yalnızca sayı olarak gösterilir (rezervasyonlar, misafirler, saatler, durum), misafir adları veya iletişim bilgileri asla gösterilmez. Rezervasyonları yanıtlamak, değiştirmek veya iptal etmek, ekran menüleri ve basılı menüler momoscreen uygulamasında kalır. Sohbet hesabını silemez.
